raw_response.rationale: The full text (31 pages) presents a mixed-methods case study of urban drinking water systems in four Ethiopian cities (Addis Ababa, Adama, Mekelle, and Dire Dawa) combining descriptive city/WHO water coverage and non-revenue water (NRW) percentages (Tables 1-3), deterministic geometric population/demand and rainwater-harvesting projections (Eqs. 1-3, Table 4, Figs. 5, 12-13), deterministic WaterGEMS hydraulic and chlorine-residual network simulations (Table 5, Figs. 7-10), and qualitative narrative from key informant interviews and field observations on institutional and governance problems (Section 4.1.8). No inferential statistical models, hypothesis tests, regressions, correlations, standard errors, confidence intervals, or p-values are reported anywhere in the study.
